feed_summary: View CSAF Summary Successful exploitation of these vulnerabilities could allow an attacker to gain control of the brakes of a trailer, modify the firmware, disable the brake lights, modify the brake conditions or disable other critical safety features. The following versions of Elecbrakes EB2, VM1, ELBC2000 are affected: EB2 <=3.0.4.2.0 (CVE-2026-124281, CVE-2026-125273, CVE-2026-96805) ELBC2000 vers:all/* (CVE-2026-124281, CVE-2026-125273, CVE-2026-96805) VM1 <1.3.4.2.1 (CVE-2026-124281, CVE-2026-125273, CVE-2026-96805) CVSS Vendor Equipment v3 9.6 Elecbrakes EB2 3 Vulnerabilities Exposed Dangerous Method or Function, Authentication Bypass by Capture-replay, Missing Authentication for Critical Function Background Critical Infrastructure Sectors: Transportation Systems Countries/Areas Depl
